parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

>  You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: Resource
parameters.description: The name of the protected object or protected object group, or the ID of the protected asset to query.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the protected resource.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the protection rule.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The name of the protection rule.

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The type of the protection rule. Valid values:
- **defense** (default): protection rule.
- **whitelist**: whitelist rule.

parameters.name: TemplateName
parameters.description: The name of the protection template to query.
